Subject: Implementation Runway & Gatekeeper Schedule — Silverline Medical MAP

Hi Elena and Mark,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. As promised, I attached a first-draft MAP (Silverline_MAP_v1.xlsx) outlining the 90-day runway, major milestones, and recommended gatekeepers. This version focuses on a phased activation so your clinical team can pilot with the triage assistant before we expand to outpatient scheduling.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm go/no-go gate on Day 30 (pilot acceptance criteria) — owner: Silverline Clinical Lead
- Finalize SOC/Procurement checklist for data retention and access — owner: Paul Nguyen / Procurement
- Agree on SSO and KMS test window (we need two weeks for certs) — owner: Jordan (Redwood) + Mark (Silverline)

Suggested milestones (excerpt):
1) Week 0 (Apr 12) — Environment provisioning + API keys (Redwood infra)
2) Week 1–2 — Connect SSO, test KMS integration (security)
3) Week 3–4 — Pilot dataset ingest + prefix caching tuning
4) Week 5–8 — Pilot with 3 clinics, daily telemetry review
5) Week 9 — Pilot acceptance and go/no-go gate
6) Week 10–12 — Gradual ramp to 8 clinics, cutover calendar

Please review the attached and call out any conflicts with internal gates. I’ve put Ben on the thread to coordinate the acceptance criteria doc and Jordan to own SSO/KMS coordination.

Attachments: Silverline_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_Silverline_stub.pdf

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

Camila — thanks for the doc. Quick notes after an initial internal sync with Mark and procurement: 

- Procurement (Paul) needs the SOC-2 artifacts and data flow diagram before signing the SOW. Can you share the SOC attestation and a redacted flow?
- The Day 30 gate is fine but we need clearer pilot acceptance criteria. Can Ben draft the acceptance checklist (pass/fail metrics) and share by Monday?
- SSO timeline: Mark can free up an ID team engineer the week of Apr 19 for two days; can Jordan provide estimated config steps so Mark’s team can plan?

Also: our Privacy officer asked whether Redwood can commit to 90-day data purge for pilot logs — is that doable?

Thanks Elena — I’ll take the acceptance checklist. Draft below (I’ll put into shared sheet):

Pilot Acceptance Criteria (proposed):
- Functional: 95% successful intent recognition on triage prompts over a rolling 48-hour window
- Latency: 99th percentile <= 320ms for triage flows during pilot traffic (observed)
- Stability: No production crashes; error rate < 0.5% per day
- Data handling: Pilot logs retained for 30 days (per request), with support for 90-day purge plan to be executed after pilot if required
- Security: SSO configured and validated; KMS integration verified for encrypted at-rest keys

Action items I’ll own:
- Convert criteria into a scoring sheet and share Monday (Apr 12)
- Coordinate with Jordan on SSO/KMS steps

Hi team — scheduling note: I primed our SSO/KMS runbook and captured the expected tasks for Silverline’s ID team. Summary: 
- Prework (1 day): Exchange SP metadata + verify assertion URL
- Config (1 day): IdP side changes + test assertions (Mark’s engineer)
- Validation (1 day): End-to-end test with staging users (Redwood + Silverline)

I can run the validation on Apr 21 or Apr 22. Mark — you mentioned your engineer will be available Apr 19; if we get the SP metadata by Apr 16 I’ll slot the config on Apr 19 and validation Apr 21.

Also captured a short privacy compromise: we can support a 90-day purge process for non-critical logs with an agreed process owner. For the pilot we’ll default to a 30-day retention window and schedule the 90-day purge at pilot close if needed.
